title: You don't have to earn your rest (hammock reel, vivid)

captions.instagram:
You don't have to earn your rest. 🔋

Not after the dishes, not after the last message, not after everyone else is sorted.
Rest is how you refill. It isn't a prize for finishing.
Today, try ten quiet minutes, and let the guilt talk without obeying it.

Send this to someone who never stops.

#rest #selfcare #slowliving #emotionalwellness #soundmind
